ctx.x: through there, who had that kind of style. Little Richard was one of them. He stopped and went to preaching. But he was one of them. But Ray, mostly he was a... He's the one who started that around this part of the country. Especially here in Dallas and back out West here -- West Texas.
Apart from the Ray Charles group, with the little groups that you had at this time, you were mainly using your brother Boston(?) on piano, weren't you?
